fact.thing: flat trading fee on every crypto order
fact.claim: Wealthsimple charges a flat 0.5% trading fee on every crypto order, and recurring buys count as orders. Market orders also carry a price spread that changes with market conditions, and Wealthsimple does not publish a fixed number for it. You only see the actual spread in the order screen before you confirm. Orders under $100 add a $1 surcharge, so a weekly buy of exactly $100 pays 0.5% (about $26 a year on $5,200) plus whatever the spread is. Active Trader accounts and limit orders pay no spread.

plain.what: Wealthsimple is a Canadian app where people buy crypto. It takes a flat 0.5% fee on every crypto order, which is 50 cents on every $100, and a repeating weekly order counts as an order each time. If an order is under $100, it adds $1 on top, so a $99 order pays about $1.50 instead of $0.50.
plain.so_what: Put in $100 a week and you've moved $5,200 in a year and paid about $26 in fees, but at $99 a week the same year costs about $78.
plain.do: Open your app today and write down two things: your weekly buy amount and your order type.
